plan.title: SRC-NEG-007 Counter Offer Rejected During Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ in evaluation with Vendor A and Vendor B bids on the buyer’s Responses tab.
Enable counter offers on RFQs as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Send the buyer’s counter offer to Vendor A at the requested price.
Confirm the buyer’s counter offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Move to Vendor A’s supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer is shown.
Click the vendor-side Reject control named in the case; the catalog has no dedicated counter-offer rejection step.
Check for the vendor screen’s visible rejection indication, if rendered.
Return to the buyer’s event page.
Open Master QCS to inspect Vendor A’s resulting bid price.
Verify Vendor A’s original price remains 100 after the rejection.
